study.question: Does an additive shared-ancestor merge of the complete compact-evidence branch and timing_joint outperform BOTH frozen source bests, especially timing_joint, after matching appended capacity and replacing source-specific evidence with redundant inputs?
study.hypothesis: Observed baseline AUCs are0.6050036145 static,0.6102261137 pooled and0.6133619861 DIN-style. The compact source reaches0.6232923298, while timing_joint reaches0.6306853561 (difference0.0073930264), so compact usefulness beside the stronger model is unresolved. Source slices suggest possible complementarity only exploratorily: compact empty-history AUC0.5990212 versus timing0.5906131 on8272 impressions/310 positives, and its low-history logloss is lower; overall and most large slices favor timing. Empty-history variation cannot be evidence for history moments because the new bias-free inputs are zero there. The compact source magnitude witness also loses orientation (selected feature difference about7.8e-10), so no orientation mechanism is assumed. Predict that sharing the ancestor while retaining both source-specific residual stacks may improve full-population AUC beyond timing_joint; if continuous compact detail matters, its effect should survive histogram duplication in both transition backgrounds. Source ancestry and adaptive validation selection make redundancy, extra capacity and optimization plausible alternatives.

nearest_work.difference: All timing classes retained verbatim except public Model renamed _FrozenTimingModel. No timing input, gap parameterization, inherited optimizer/loss or model dimension changes. The new final subclass adds the other source-specific residuals with an explicit2x2 evidence replacement.

Inherit exchangeable/observed transition features and all four selected source maps/readout architectures: histogram, conditional within-bin mean, observed variance, absolute central third. Source feature/readout/oracle methods transplanted unchanged. Share the ancestor once with timing instead of training a second embedding model. New heads follow timing allocations, so the standalone source scratch RNG trajectory is not reproduced.

DIN describes target-adaptive weighted history pooling. The supplied baseline is field-adapted softmax attention, whereas DIN text explicitly abandons softmax normalization (lines270-277); it is not an exact DIN reproduction. This proposal tests deterministic compact event statistics plus timing residual complementarity, not a new attention unit. No priority/novelty claim.

Only pinned author README is authorized/available; full publisher mechanism remains unverified. It confirms category, brand and behavior type without item identity. We add no item IDs or matching labels and make no detailed DMR comparison/reproduction claim.

study.proposed_difference: Add an independently parameterized exchangeable transition head16400 parameters and four compact gated heads17024 parameters AFTER all timing allocations: total33424 extra, expected17286819 total/208131 dense with unchanged17078688 embeddings. Compute the exact timing logit and sum five zero-initialized bias-free residuals. The2x2 controls select exchangeable versus duplicated chronological transition inputs and compact detail versus repeated ancestor histograms; all feature alternatives and heads allocate/execute equally. This is a mechanism-distinct recombination of available local sources, not a claim that its primitive statistics or residual fusion are novel. Reconstructing standalone compact predictions after joint retraining is not source checkpoint reproduction.
predictions: Primary: merge_full must beat BOTH frozen source AUCs, especially0.6306853561453415 timing_joint; report the two deltas explicitly with unweighted logloss. A single-seed positive result is provisional.

Compact detail: full>coarse and compact>duplicate under matched heads; source-specific transitions: full>compact and coarse>duplicate. Report all four contrasts and their descriptive interaction, including null/negative cells.

Host diagnostic requirements: reconstructed timing logits agree with original timing forward, independent direct-cell/dense oracles agree within floating-point tolerance, logits/features finite, empty/zero-length and zero-input residuals zero, padding/input-order invariance holds.

Representational witness: ages[40000,45000,50000,55000] versus[41000,45000,50000,55000] on the same category/brand and actions[1,1,2,2] preserve inherited log2/coarse-age, transitions, gap bins and timing counts but change compact continuous statistics. Feature distinction demonstrates access only, not predictive usefulness.
Costs: added heads/moment computations may worsen measured training or inference cost. Claim quality benefit and efficiency separately; no efficiency result is predicted as certain.
falsifiers: No full-population improvement over timing_joint, even if the compact source is beaten, leaves incremental utility unsupported for this implementation.
A full gain reproduced by merge_duplicate or merge_coarse fails to support the richer compact-evidence interpretation. A transition-only effect does not establish a compact-moment effect.
No repeatable compact-detail contrast across paired seeds, unacceptable logloss degradation, or reversal in consequential adequately supported slices weakens selection.
Oracle, finite-output, timing-path reproduction or support-invariance failures invalidate the implementation comparison; they are execution failures rather than scientific counterevidence.
Measured quality gains without an acceptable cost tradeoff do not establish efficiency; inability to afford repetitions limits conclusion maturity.
alternative_explanations: Extra active nonlinear readouts, input scaling, sparsity or zero-initialization dynamics rather than new evidence
Useful exchangeable transition counts rather than conditional mean/variance/magnitude;2x2 contrasts distinguish the bundles but not each moment
Learned shared-ancestor changes and context gates, random initialization, adaptive validation selection, or user dependence
Truncated histories, undocumented as-of dates of publisher static snapshots, bucket collisions and missing fields limit external/production transfer
Small empty/rare slices can fluctuate and are exploratory; an empty-history gain comes from shared static retraining, not zero-valued new history inputs
